about: The site-wide settings (PRODUCT-LINE.md 5.7): the site's theme, one source for every output. An admin draws them as fields (settingsFields, components/theme/settings-panel.js) and saves what it sanitizes as said here; a server paints them with server/palette.php, a browser with lib/palette.js. Their defaults are lib/theme.defaults.json's; choicesFrom names a list the theme builds (designs: lib/design.js; hovers: styles/hovers.css's hover-* classes).

design.about: The design style: fonts, corners, shadows and surfaces

palette.about: Which palette is the site's: one of the theme's, or one of the site's own

palettes.about: The site's own palettes, each an id and two colors (up to 20)

isDark.about: Dark mode: the page dark, its text light

hover.about: The hover effect for buttons and cards whose own hover is the default; none: no effect

dark.about: The dark color: text in light mode, the page in dark mode

light.about: The light color: the page in light mode, text in dark mode

vars.about: CSS variables over the theme's, --name: value (a value can't close the rule)

visitor.about: What visitors may change for themselves: the full mini theme editor, or single controls

full.about: A Theme button that opens every control

expiresDays.about: How many days a visitor's own theme lasts

checks.contrast: lib/palette.js contrastChecks (server/palette.php contrast): the text on each brand color and the primary color on the page under WCAG AA's 4.5:1, a warning
